mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO product_embedding (product_id, model, dim, vector) VALUES
(#{item.productId}, #{item.model}, #{item.dim}, #{item.vector})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE model = VALUES(model), dim = VALUES(dim), vector = VALUES(vector), updated_at = NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, model, dim, vector FROM product_embedding WHERE product_id IN #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.tags, c.name AS category_name FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.status = 1 LEFT JOIN product_embedding e ON e.product_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'ON_SALE' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (e.product_id IS NULL OR e.updated_at < p.updated_at) ORDER BY p.updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT e.product_id FROM product_embedding e LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = e.product_id WHERE p.id IS NULL OR p.status <> 'ON_SALE' OR p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT #{limit}
